mapper.select: SELECT id::text AS id, user_id::text AS user_id FROM chat_sessions WHERE id = CAST(#{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)
INSERT INTO chat_sessions(user_id) VALUES (CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)) RETURNING id::text

SELECT id::text AS id, title, summary, last_routed, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at) AS created_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM updated_at) AS updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_messages m WHERE m.session_id = s.id) AS message_count FROM chat_sessions s WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT id::text AS id, title, summary, last_routed, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at) AS created_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM updated_at) AS updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_messages m WHERE m.session_id = s.id) AS message_count FROM chat_sessions s WHERE id = CAST(#{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)

SELECT role, content, reasoning, tool_name, arguments::text AS arguments_json, parsed::text AS parsed_json, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at) AS ts FROM chat_messages WHERE session_id = CAST(#{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND session_id IN ( SELECT id FROM chat_sessions WHERE id = CAST(#{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) ) ORDER BY id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_sessions WHERE id = CAST(#{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_sessions SET summary = #{summary, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, title = #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = CAST(#{sessionId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)
